briefing.headline: Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO, and AI and chip stocks have swung sharply since.

points.text: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. Reports say the stock closed up 31% that day.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia has halted some AI server shipments to South-East Asia, one outlet reports.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia chip buyers were reportedly told to rule out Chinese renters when buying GPUs. The move follows a new US rule meant to close loopholes.
points.label: reported

points.text: Asian chip stocks fell sharply despite record earnings, as fears of a slowdown in the chip cycle grew.
points.label: reported

points.text: Some commentators say the Huang return is a serious governance mistake. Others say it calmed the market.
points.label: opinion
